**Auto-generated by YOURA Research Pipeline (Phase 6.5.1)**

## Quick Start (Overleaf)

1. Zip this directory and upload to Overleaf
2. Set compiler: pdfLaTeX
3. Run: pdfLaTeX → BibTeX → pdfLaTeX → pdfLaTeX

## Local Compilation

```bash
cd paper/overleaf/
pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode main.tex
bibtex main
pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode main.tex
pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode main.tex
```

## File Structure

- `main.tex` - Main document
- `references.bib` - Bibliography (203 entries)
- `sections/*.tex` - 8 section files
- `icml2025.sty` - ICML 2025 style (included)

## Before Submission

1. Replace author information in main.tex
2. Check all citations match references.bib
3. Verify figures copied to figures/ directory
